line.relation_role: discovery seed only; may contain nested route relations
line.physical_model_rule: Two independent physical centerlines must be extracted from OSM/project ways. Track B must never be produced by a constant lateral offset from Track A.

coordinate_policy.horizontal: OSM WGS84 may be transformed to engineering CRS for a plan approximation, but is not an engineering survey.
coordinate_policy.vertical: Do not invent Z. z_ugr_m remains null until survey/profile evidence is attached.
coordinate_policy.switch_xy: Do not use station coordinates as switch coordinates; keep null until an actual physical way/node or drawing is resolved.

notes: Current Moscow Transport independently states that trains leave Krasnaya Presnya depot onto the first track and that first-track travel is clockwise.
Historical metro track literature explicitly calls the clockwise inner track the first track.
Current Moscow Transport states that depot trains entering the second track take their first passengers at Krasnopresnenskaya, consistent with counterclockwise travel.
This track is not a generated offset of Track A.
